        return "Murderer"

        return "Sheriff"
    end

        local Gun = Backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")

            Gun = Backpack:FindFirstChild("Default")
        end

        Backpack = Gun
    end

    if Backpack then
        return "Sheriff"
    end

    return "Innocent"

        if p21 then
            v22:Notify({
				Title = "Anti-Aim",
				Content = "Waiting for character to load...",
				Duration = 2
			})
        end

        return
    end

        return

        value4_2.AntiAim.SpinAngle = 0

            value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate:Disconnect()
        end

        value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            if not value4_2.AntiAim.Active or not HumanoidRootPart then
                if value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate then
                    value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate:Disconnect()
                    value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate = nil
                end

                return
            end

            local AntiAimMode = t5.Movement.AntiAim.Mode
            local AntiAimSpeed = t5.Movement.AntiAim.Speed
            local Intensity = t5.Movement.AntiAim.Intensity

            if AntiAimMode == "Jitter" then
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-Intensity, Intensity) / 100, math.random(-Intensity, Intensity) / 100, math.random(-Intensity, Intensity) / 100)

                HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(vector3)

                return
            end

            if AntiAimMode == "Spin" then
                value4_2.AntiAim.SpinAngle = (value4_2.AntiAim.SpinAngle + AntiAimSpeed * dt * 10) % 360

                local v622 = math.rad(value4_2.AntiAim.SpinAngle)
                local vector3 = Vector3.new(math.sin(v622) * 2, 0, math.cos(v622) * 2)

                HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(HumanoidRootPart.Position + vector3, HumanoidRootPart.Position)

                return
            end

            if AntiAimMode == "Desync" then
                local timestamp = tick()
                local v625 = math.sin(timestamp * AntiAimSpeed) * Intensity / 50

                HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, v625, 0)
            end
        end)

        local AntiAimMode = t5.Movement.AntiAim.Mode
        local v179 = v22
        local Notify = v179.Notify
        local v181 = "Anti-Aim enabled! Mode: " .. AntiAimMode

        Notify(v179, {
			Title = "Anti-Aim",
			Content = v181,
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local v182 = HumanoidRootPart

    if v182 then
        v182 = value4_2.AntiAim.OriginalCFrame
    end

    if v182 then
        HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = value4_2.AntiAim.OriginalCFrame
    end

    if value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate then
        value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate:Disconnect()
        value4_2.AntiAim.Connections.AntiAimUpdate = nil
    end

		Title = "Anti-Aim",
		Content = "Anti-Aim disabled",
		Duration = 2
	})
end

        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro.Parent = HumanoidRootPart
        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(40000, 40000, 40000)
        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity.P = 1000
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(40000, 40000, 40000)
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro.P = 1000
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro.D = 50
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, false)

        if value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate then
            value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate:Disconnect()
        end

        value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(_)
            local v627 = not value4_2.Flight.Active

            if not v627 then
                v627 = not Character or not HumanoidRootPart
            end

            if v627 then
                if value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate then
                    value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate:Disconnect()
                    value4_2.Flight.Connections.FlightUpdate = nil
                end

                return
            end

            local CurrentCamera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local vector3 = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Forward]) then
                vector3 += CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Backward]) then
                vector3 -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Left]) then
                vector3 -= CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Right]) then
                vector3 += CurrentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Up]) then
                vector3 += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode[t5.Movement.Flight.Controls.Down]) then
                vector3 -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            if vector3.Magnitude > 0 then
                local Unit = vector3.Unit

                value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity.Velocity = Unit * t5.Movement.Flight.Speed
            else
                value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            end

            value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame
        end)
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Flight Mode",
			Content = "Flight enabled! Use WASD + Space/LCtrl to fly",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    if value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity then
        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity:Destroy()
        value4_2.Flight.BodyVelocity = nil
    end

    if value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro then
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro:Destroy()
        value4_2.Flight.BodyGyro = nil
    end

    if Humanoid then
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
        Humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
    end

    for _, v in pairs(value4_2.Flight.Connections) do
        if v then
            v:Disconnect()
        end
    end

    value4_2.Flight.Connections = {}
    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Flight Mode",
		Content = "Flight disabled",
		Duration = 2
	})
end
function t1.value20(p25, p26, p27)
    local InnocentColor = t5.ESP.InnocentColor
    local MurdererColor = t5.ESP.MurdererColor
    local SheriffColor = t5.ESP.SheriffColor
    local HeroColor = t5.ESP.HeroColor
    local SpectatorColor = t5.ESP.SpectatorColor
    local UnknownColor = t5.ESP.UnknownColor
    local t17 = {
		Innocent = InnocentColor,
		Murderer = MurdererColor,
		Sheriff = SheriffColor,
		Hero = HeroColor,
		Spectator = SpectatorColor,
		Unknown = UnknownColor
	}

    if t5.ESP.ColorMode == "Role" then
        local v202 = t17[p26] or t17.Unknown

        if p27 == "Knife" then
            return t17.Murderer
        end

        if p27 == "Gun" then
            return t17.Sheriff
        end

        return v202
    end

    if t5.ESP.ColorMode == "Team" then
        return p25.TeamColor.Color
    end

    if p26 == "Innocent" then
        return t5.ESP.InnocentColor
    end

    if p26 == "Murderer" then
        return t5.ESP.MurdererColor
    end

    if p26 == "Sheriff" then
        return t5.ESP.SheriffColor
    end

    if p26 == "Hero" then
        return t5.ESP.HeroColor
    end

    if p26 == "Spectator" then
        return t5.ESP.SpectatorColor
    end

    return t5.ESP.UnknownColor
end
function t1.value23(p28, p29)
    local _mousemoverel = mousemoverel

    if not _mousemoverel then
        _mousemoverel = Input

        if _mousemoverel then
            _mousemoverel = Input.MouseMoveRelative
        end

        if not _mousemoverel then
            _mousemoverel = MouseMoveRelative or MouseMoveRel
        end
    end

    if _mousemoverel then
        _mousemoverel(p28, p29)

        return
    end

    if not getgenv().MM2_Aimbot_ErrorNotified then
        getgenv().MM2_Aimbot_ErrorNotified = true
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Aimbot Error",
			Content = "Your executor lacks a mouse movement function",
			Duration = 5
		})
    end
end
local value18 = t1.value18
function t1.value21(p30, _)
    local players = Players:GetPlayers()
    local t18 = {}
    for v212, v213 in ipairs(players) do

        if v213 ~= LocalPlayer and v213.Character then
            value17(v213)

            local v214 = value18(v213)

            if p30 == "Murderer" and v214 == "Knife" then
                table.insert(t18, {
					Player = v213,
					Distance = 0
				})
            elseif p30 == "Sheriff" and v214 == "Gun" then
                table.insert(t18, {
					Player = v213,
					Distance = 0
				})
            end
        end
    end
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if Character then
        local Position = Character:GetPivot().Position

        for _, v in ipairs(t18) do
            if v.Player.Character then
                v.Distance = (Position - v.Player.Character:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
            end
        end

        table.sort(t18, function(p32, p33)
            return p32.Distance < p33.Distance
        end)
    end

    return t18
end
function t1.value24(p34)
    if not t5.GunESP.Aimbot.WallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        return false
    end

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()

    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
		Character,
		CurrentCamera
	}

    local CFramePosition = CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
    local v224 = p34.Position - CFramePosition
    local raycastResult = workspace:Raycast(CFramePosition, v224, raycastParams)

    if raycastResult then
        return raycastResult.Instance:IsDescendantOf(p34.Parent)
    end

    return true
end

			Duration = 3
		})

function t1.value35()
    if not t5.GunESP.Enabled then
        return
    end

    for _, v in pairs(t11) do
        local Highlight = v.Highlight

        if Highlight then
            Highlight = v.Highlight.Parent
        end

        if Highlight then
            v.Highlight:Destroy()
        end
    end

    t11 = {}

    for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local v251 = descendant.Name == "GunDrop"

        if not v251 then
            v251 = descendant.Name == "Gun"

            if not v251 then
                v251 = descendant.Name == "Default"
            end
        end

        if v251 then
            local v252 = true
            local Model = descendant:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

            if Model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Model) then
                v252 = false
            end

            if v252 then
                local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

                Highlight.Name = "GunESP_" .. tostring(descendant)
                Highlight.FillColor = t5.GunESP.OutlineColor
                Highlight.OutlineColor = t5.GunESP.OutlineColor
                Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.8
                Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

                if descendant:IsA("Model") then
                    Highlight.Parent = descendant
                elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                    Highlight.Adornee = descendant
                    Highlight.Parent = workspace
                end

                table.insert(t11, {
					Object = descendant,
					Highlight = Highlight
				})
            end
        end
    end
end

function t1.value31(p39)
    if p39 == value4_2.Blackhole.Active then
        return
    end
    value4_2.Blackhole.Active = p39
    t5.Teleport.Blackhole.Enabled = p39
    t7:SaveSetting("Teleport", "Blackhole", t5.Teleport.Blackhole)
    if value4_2.Blackhole.VisualPart then
        value4_2.Blackhole.VisualPart:Destroy()
        value4_2.Blackhole.VisualPart = nil
    end
    for v263, v264 in pairs(value4_2.Blackhole.Connections) do

        if v264 then
            v264:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    value4_2.Blackhole.Connections = {}
    if p39 then
        local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

        if not value30(Character) then
            v22:Notify({
				Title = "Error",
				Content = "Character not loaded! Reset or wait.",
				Duration = 2
			})
            value4_2.Blackhole.Active = false

            return
        end

        local Part = Instance.new("Part")

        Part.Name = "VortexVisual_Local"
        Part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        Part.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
        Part.Transparency = 0.7
        Part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        Part.CanCollide = false
        Part.Anchored = true
        Part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
        Part.Parent = Character
        value4_2.Blackhole.VisualPart = Part
        value4_2.Blackhole.Connections.Update = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not value4_2.Blackhole.Active then
                return
            end

            local Character2 = LocalPlayer.Character
            local v640 = value30(Character2)

            if not Character2 or not v640 then
                return
            end

            local v641 = v640.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -t5.Teleport.Blackhole.HoldDistance)

            Part.CFrame = v641

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
                    local v644 = value30(player.Character)
                    local Humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                    local v646 = v644

                    if v644 then
                        v646 = Humanoid and Humanoid.Health > 0
                    end

                    if v646 then
                        if (v640.Position - v644.Position).Magnitude <= t5.Teleport.Blackhole.Range then
                            v644.CFrame = v641
                            v644.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            v644.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                            Humanoid.PlatformStand = true

                            for _, descendant in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                                if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.CanCollide then
                                    descendant.CanCollide = false
                                end
                            end
                        elseif Humanoid.PlatformStand then
                            Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Vortex ON",
			Content = "Players are now stuck to you on your screen!",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end
    for v269, v270 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

        local Character = v270.Character

        if Character then
            Character = v270.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        end

        if Character then
            v270.Character.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        end
    end
    for _, v in pairs(value4_2.Blackhole.Connections) do
        if v then
            v:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    value4_2.Blackhole.Connections = {}
    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Vortex OFF",
		Content = "Players released",
		Duration = 2
	})
end

	})

function t1.value39()
    if t5.GunESP.Aimbot.Enabled then
        local v292 = u65()

        if v292 and v292.Character then
            local t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart = v292.Character:FindFirstChild(t5.GunESP.Aimbot.TargetPart)

            if not t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart then
                t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart = v292.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end

            if t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart and value24(t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart) then
                local v294, v295 = value16(t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart.Position)

                if v295 then
                    local v296 = v294 - UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

                    value23(v296.X * 0.25, v296.Y * 0.25)
                end
            end
        end

        if t5.GunESP.Aimbot.ShowFOV then
            value37.Visible = true
            value37.Radius = t5.GunESP.Aimbot.FOV
            value37.Position = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

            return
        end
    end

    value37.Visible = false
end
function u65()
    local v297
    local FOV = t5.GunESP.Aimbot.FOV
    local MouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and value17(player) == "Murderer" then
            local t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild(t5.GunESP.Aimbot.TargetPart)

            if not t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart then
                t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end

            if t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart then
                local v304, t19Result = value16(t5GunESPAimbotTargetPart.Position)
                if t19Result then
                    local Magnitude = (MouseLocation - v304).Magnitude

                    if Magnitude < FOV then
                        FOV = Magnitude
                        v297 = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return v297
end

local n3 = 0
local function v70()
    if not t5.Combat.HitboxExpander.Enabled then
        return
    end

    local v310 = false

    if tick() - n3 > 0.1 then
        n3 = tick()
        v310 = true
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local v312 = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("Knife")

    if v312 then
        v312 = v312:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    end

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local HumanoidRootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if HumanoidRootPart then
                HumanoidRootPart.Size = Vector3.new(t5.Combat.HitboxExpander.Size, t5.Combat.HitboxExpander.Size, t5.Combat.HitboxExpander.Size)
                HumanoidRootPart.Transparency = t5.Combat.HitboxExpander.Transparency
                HumanoidRootPart.CanCollide = false

                if firetouchinterest and v312 then
                    local Torso = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")

                    if not Torso then
                        Torso = player.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                    end

                    local Head = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

                    if HumanoidRootPart then
                        firetouchinterest(HumanoidRootPart, v312, 0)
                        firetouchinterest(HumanoidRootPart, v312, 1)
                    end

                    if Torso then
                        firetouchinterest(Torso, v312, 0)
                        firetouchinterest(Torso, v312, 1)
                    end

                    if Head then
                        firetouchinterest(Head, v312, 0)
                        firetouchinterest(Head, v312, 1)
                    end
                end

                if v310 then
                    HumanoidRootPart.CanTouch = false
                    task.delay(0.01, function()
                        if HumanoidRootPart then
                            HumanoidRootPart.CanTouch = true
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function v73()
    if not t5.Coin.ShowCoinESP then
        return
    end

    for _, v in pairs(t13) do
        local Highlight = v.Highlight

        if Highlight then
            Highlight = v.Highlight.Parent
        end

        if Highlight then
            v.Highlight:Destroy()
        end
    end

    t13 = {}

    for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local v323 = descendant.Name:find("Coin")
        if not v323 then
            v323 = descendant.Name:find("Money")
        end
        if not v323 then
            continue
        end
        local v324 = false
        local GetDescendants = descendant.GetDescendants
        for v328, v329 in pairs(GetDescendants(descendant)) do

            local v330 = v329:IsA("TouchTransmitter")

            if not v330 then
                v330 = v329.Name:find("Touch")
            end

            if v330 then
                v324 = true

                break
            end
        end
        if v324 then
            local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

            Highlight.Name = "CoinESP_" .. tostring(descendant)
            Highlight.FillColor = t5.Coin.OutlineColor
            Highlight.OutlineColor = t5.Coin.OutlineColor
            Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.9
            Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
            Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop

            if descendant:IsA("Model") then
                Highlight.Parent = descendant
            elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                Highlight.Adornee = descendant
                Highlight.Parent = workspace
            end

            table.insert(t13, {
				Object = descendant,
				Highlight = Highlight
			})
        end
    end
end

    if p47 then
        t16.LastActivity = tick()

        if t5.AntiAFK.Method == "Movement" then
            t16.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if tick() - t16.LastActivity > t5.AntiAFK.Interval then
                    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

                    if Character then
                        local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

                        if Humanoid then
                            local t20 = { Vector3.new(0, 0, 0.01) }

                            Humanoid:Move(v2(t20))
                        end
                    end

                    t16.LastActivity = tick()
                end
            end)
        else
            t16.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if tick() - t16.LastActivity > t5.AntiAFK.Interval then
                    local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

                    if CurrentCamera then
                        CurrentCamera.CFrame = CurrentCamera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0.017453292519943295, 0)
                    end

                    t16.LastActivity = tick()
                end
            end)
        end

        UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function()
            t16.LastActivity = tick()
        end)

        local v287 = v22
        local v288 = "Anti-AFK enabled (" .. t5.AntiAFK.Method .. " method)"

        v287:Notify({
			Title = "Anti-AFK",
			Content = v288,
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    if t16.Connection then
        t16.Connection:Disconnect()
        t16.Connection = nil
    end

    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Anti-AFK",
		Content = "Anti-AFK disabled",
		Duration = 2
	})
end

function UpdateESP(p49)
    if not t9[p49] then
        return
    end

    local v379 = t9[p49]
    local Character = p49.Character
    local v381 = t10[p49]

    if not Character then
        SetESPVisible(v379, false)

        return
    end

    local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local v383 = not HumanoidRootPart
    local Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

    if not v383 then
        v383 = not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0
    end

    if v383 then
        SetESPVisible(v379, false)

        if v379.Highlight then
            v379.Highlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return
    end

    local v385 = value17(p49)
    local v386 = value18(p49)
    local v387, v388 = value19(p49)
    local Magnitude = (HumanoidRootPart.Position - workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

    if Magnitude > t5.ESP.MaxDistance then
        SetESPVisible(v379, false)

        if v379.Highlight then
            v379.Highlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return
    end

    v381.Role = v385
    v381.Weapon = v386
    v381.LastUpdate = tick()

    local v390 = value20(p49, v385, v386)

    if v390 ~= v381.LastColor then
        v381.LastColor = v390
    end

    local v391, v392, v393 = value16(HumanoidRootPart.Position)

    if not v392 then
        SetESPVisible(v379, false)

        if v379.Highlight then
            v379.Highlight.Enabled = false
        end

        return
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowHighlight then
        if not v379.Highlight then
            v379.Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            v379.Highlight.Name = "ESP_Highlight_" .. p49.UserId
            v379.Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            v379.Highlight.Parent = Character
        end

        if Character ~= v379.Highlight.Parent then
            v379.Highlight.Parent = Character
        end

        if t5.ESP.ColorMode == "Role" then
            v379.Highlight.FillColor = v390
            v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = v390
        elseif t5.ESP.ColorMode == "Custom" then
            if v385 == "Murderer" then
                v379.Highlight.FillColor = t5.ESP.MurdererColor
                v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = t5.ESP.MurdererColor
            elseif v385 == "Sheriff" then
                v379.Highlight.FillColor = t5.ESP.SheriffColor
                v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = t5.ESP.SheriffColor
            elseif v385 == "Innocent" then
                v379.Highlight.FillColor = t5.ESP.InnocentColor
                v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = t5.ESP.InnocentColor
            else
                v379.Highlight.FillColor = v390
                v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = v390
            end
        else
            v379.Highlight.FillColor = v390
            v379.Highlight.OutlineColor = v390
        end

        v379.Highlight.FillTransparency = t5.ESP.HighlightFillTransparency
        v379.Highlight.OutlineTransparency = t5.ESP.HighlightOutlineTransparency
        v379.Highlight.Enabled = true
    elseif v379.Highlight then
        v379.Highlight.Enabled = false
    end

    local vector2 = Vector2.new(2000 / v393, 3000 / v393)
    local vector2_2 = Vector2.new(v391.X - vector2.X / 2, v391.Y - vector2.Y / 2)

    if t5.ESP.ShowBox then
        v379.Box.Size = vector2
        v379.Box.Position = vector2_2
        v379.Box.Color = v390
        v379.Box.Visible = true
    else
        v379.Box.Visible = false
    end

    local n4 = 0
    local n5 = 2

    if t5.ESP.ShowName then
        v379.Name.Position = Vector2.new(v391.X, v391.Y - vector2.Y / 2 - n5 - n4)
        v379.Name.Text = p49.Name
        v379.Name.Color = v390
        v379.Name.Visible = true
        n4 = n4 + t5.ESP.TextSize + n5
    else
        v379.Name.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowRole then
        v379.Role.Position = Vector2.new(v391.X, v391.Y - vector2.Y / 2 - n5 - n4)
        v379.Role.Text = v385
        v379.Role.Color = v390
        v379.Role.Visible = true
        n4 = n4 + t5.ESP.TextSize + n5
    else
        v379.Role.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowWeapon then
        v379.Weapon.Position = Vector2.new(v391.X, v391.Y - vector2.Y / 2 - n5 - n4)
        v379.Weapon.Text = t8[v386].Icon .. " " .. v386
        v379.Weapon.Color = v390
        v379.Weapon.Visible = true
        n4 = n4 + t5.ESP.TextSize + n5
    else
        v379.Weapon.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowHealth then
        v379.Health.Position = Vector2.new(v391.X, v391.Y - vector2.Y / 2 - n5 - n4)
        v379.Health.Text = string.format("❤\239\184\143 %d/%d", math.floor(v387), (math.floor(v388)))

        local v398 = v387 / v388

        v379.Health.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255 * (1 - v398), 255 * v398, 0)
        v379.Health.Visible = true

        local _ = n4 + t5.ESP.TextSize + n5
    else
        v379.Health.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowDistance then
        v379.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(v391.X, v391.Y + vector2.Y / 2 + n5)
        v379.Distance.Text = string.format("[%d studs]", (math.floor(Magnitude)))
        v379.Distance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        v379.Distance.Visible = true
    else
        v379.Distance.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowTracers then
        local ViewportSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        local v401 = ViewportSize.X / 2
        local v402 = ViewportSize.Y / 2

        v379.Tracer.From = Vector2.new(v401, v402)
        v379.Tracer.To = v391
        v379.Tracer.Color = v390
        v379.Tracer.Visible = true
    else
        v379.Tracer.Visible = false
    end

    if t5.ESP.ShowSkeleton then
        UpdateSkeleton(v379, Character, v390)

        return
    end

    SetSkeletonVisible(v379, false)
end
function SetESPVisible(p50, p51)
    if p50.Box then
        p50.Box.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Name then
        p50.Name.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Distance then
        p50.Distance.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Health then
        p50.Health.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Weapon then
        p50.Weapon.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Role then
        p50.Role.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Tracer then
        p50.Tracer.Visible = p51
    end

    if p50.Highlight then
        local Highlight = p50.Highlight
        local v406 = p51

        if p51 then
            v406 = t5.ESP.ShowHighlight
        end

        Highlight.Enabled = v406
    end

    if p50.Skeleton then
        for _, v in pairs(p50.Skeleton) do
            if v then
                local v409 = p51

                if p51 then
                    v409 = t5.ESP.ShowSkeleton
                end

                v.Visible = v409
            end
        end
    end
end
function SetSkeletonVisible(p52, p53)
    if p52.Skeleton then
        for _, v in pairs(p52.Skeleton) do
            if v then
                v.Visible = p53
            end
        end
    end
end
function UpdateSkeleton(p54, p55, p56)
    local HumanoidRootPart = p55:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local Head = p55:FindFirstChild("Head")

    if HumanoidRootPart and Head then
        local v419, v420 = value16(HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        local v421, v422 = value16(Head.Position)

        if v420 and v422 then
            p54.Skeleton.Head.From = Vector2.new(v421.X, v421.Y)
            p54.Skeleton.Head.To = Vector2.new(v419.X, v419.Y)
            p54.Skeleton.Head.Color = p56
            p54.Skeleton.Head.Visible = true

            return
        end

        SetSkeletonVisible(p54, false)

        return
    end

    SetSkeletonVisible(p54, false)
end
function CleanupESP(p57)
    local v424 = t9[p57]

    if v424 then
        for _, v in pairs(v424) do
            if typeof(v) ~= "table" or v == v424.Skeleton then
                if typeof(v) == "table" and v == v424.Skeleton then
                    for _, v3 in pairs(v) do
                        if v3 and v3.Remove then
                            v3:Remove()
                        end
                    end
                elseif v and v.Remove then
                    v:Remove()
                end
            end
        end

        if v424.Highlight then
            v424.Highlight:Destroy()
        end

        t9[p57] = nil
        t10[p57] = nil
    end
end
function ToggleESP(p58)
    t5.ESP.Enabled = p58
    t7:SaveSetting("ESP", "Enabled", p58)

    if p58 then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                CreateESP(player)
            end
        end

        value4.ESPUpdate = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not t5.ESP.Enabled then
                return
            end

            for k, _ in pairs(t9) do
                local v662 = k

                if v662 and v662.Parent then
                    UpdateESP(v662)
                else
                    CleanupESP(v662)
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if value4.ESPUpdate then
            value4.ESPUpdate:Disconnect()
            value4.ESPUpdate = nil
        end

        for _, v in pairs(t9) do
            SetESPVisible(v, false)
        end
    end

    local v434 = v22
    local v435 = not p58 and "Disabled" or "Enabled"

    v434:Notify({
		Title = "Advanced ESP",
		Content = v435,
		Duration = 2
	})
end
local function v77(p59)
    if p59 ~= LocalPlayer then
        CreateESP(p59)
    end
end
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    v77(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(v77)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    CleanupESP(player)
end)

        end
    end

        t22 = { "No players found" }

        v526 = value48.Set

    end
end

function t1.value56()
    if s2 == "No players found" then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Content = "No player selected or no players available",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local v527 = s2:match("^(.-) %(") or s2
    local v528 = Players:FindFirstChild(v527)

    if not v528 then
        local v529 = v22
        local Notify = v529.Notify
        local v531 = "Player not found: " .. v527

        Notify(v529, {
			Title = "Error",
			Content = v531,
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

    if not Character then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Content = "Your character isn't ready!",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local Character4 = v528.Character

    if not Character4 then
        local v534 = v22
        local v535 = v527 .. "'s character isn't ready!"

        v534:Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Content = v535,
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local HumanoidRootPart2 = Character4:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not HumanoidRootPart or not HumanoidRootPart2 then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Content = "Could not find HumanoidRootPart",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart2.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)

    local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")

    Highlight.Parent = Character4
    Highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
    Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
    Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(Highlight, 3)

    local v539 = v22
    local v540 = "Teleported to " .. v527

    v539:Notify({
		Title = "Teleport Success",
		Content = v540,
		Duration = 3
	})
end

function t1.value56()
    local LocalPlayer2 = Players.LocalPlayer
    local v542 = LocalPlayer2.Character or LocalPlayer2.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace.RegularLobby.MainLobby.Parts:GetChildren()[152]
    end)
    if success then
        local v545 = workspace.RegularLobby.MainLobby.Parts:GetChildren()[152]

        if v545 then
            local v546 = v542:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or v542:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 2)

            if v546 then
                v546.CFrame = v545.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                v22:Notify({
					Title = "Teleport Success",
					Content = "Teleported to lobby!",
					Duration = 3
				})

                return
            end

            v22:Notify({
				Title = "Teleport Failed",
				Content = "Could not find HumanoidRootPart",
				Duration = 3
			})

            return
        end

        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Teleport Failed",
			Content = "Lobby part not found at index 152",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end
    local v547 = v22
    local v548 = "Error finding lobby: " .. tostring(result)
    v547:Notify({
		Title = "Teleport Failed",
		Content = v548,
		Duration = 3
	})
end

		})

        return
    end

    if #v551 > 0 then
        local Character = v551[1].Player.Character

        if Character then
            local HumanoidRootPart3 = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if HumanoidRootPart3 then
                local Distance = v551[1].Distance

                HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPart3.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -4)

                Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
                Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
                Highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(Highlight, 3)

                local v556 = v22
                local format = string.format
                local floor = math.floor
                local Notify = v556.Notify
                local v560 = format("Teleported to Murderer (%d studs away)", floor(Distance))

                Notify(v556, {
					Title = "Target Found!",
					Content = v560,
					Duration = 3
				})

                return
            end
        end
    end

    v22:Notify({
		Title = "No Murderer",
		Content = "No Murderer Found!",
		Duration = 3
	})
end

function t1.value51()
    for _, descendant in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        local v572 = descendant.Name == "GunDrop"

        if not v572 then
            v572 = descendant.Name == "Gun"
        end

        if not v572 then
            continue
        end

        local v573 = not descendant:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")

        if not v573 then
            v573 = not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(descendant:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model"))
        end

        if v573 then
            return descendant
        end
    end

    return nil
end
local value51 = t1.value51
t1.value51 = v27.CreateButton
function t1.value57()
    local LocalPlayer5 = Players.LocalPlayer
    local v575 = LocalPlayer5.Character or LocalPlayer5.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local HumanoidRootPart = v575:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not HumanoidRootPart then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Error",
			Content = "Your character isn't ready!",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local HumanoidRootPartCFrame = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
    local v578 = value51()

    if not v578 then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "No Gun Found",
			Content = "No dropped gun found in the map",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    local CFrame3

    if v578:IsA("BasePart") then
        CFrame3 = v578.CFrame
    else
        local v580 = v578:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart") or v578.PrimaryPart

        CFrame3 = if not v580 then CFrame.new(v578:GetPivot().Position) else v580.CFrame
    end

    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Gun Found",
		Content = "Teleporting to dropped gun...",
		Duration = 2
	})
    HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame3 * CFrame.new(0, 0, -2)
    wait(0.5)

    if v578:IsA("Tool") then
        v578.Parent = v575
    end

    wait(0.5)
    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Returning",
		Content = "Returning to original position...",
		Duration = 2
	})
    HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = HumanoidRootPartCFrame

    local Gun = v575:FindFirstChild("Gun")

    if not Gun then
        Gun = v575:FindFirstChild("Default")
    end

    if Gun then
        v22:Notify({
			Title = "Success!",
			Content = "Got the gun and returned safely!",
			Duration = 3
		})

        return
    end

    v22:Notify({
		Title = "Partial Success",
		Content = "Returned but couldn't pick up the gun",
		Duration = 3
	})
end

function t1.value56(p104, _)

            end
        end

        value31(false)
        t5.GunESP.Enabled = false
        t7:SaveSetting("GunESP", "Enabled", false)
        if t12.Update then
            t12.Update:Disconnect()
            t12.Update = nil
        end
        for _, v in pairs(t11) do
            if v.Highlight then
                v.Highlight:Destroy()
            end
        end
        value40(false)
        v74(false)
        ToggleESP(false)
        v75(false)
        v76(false)
        v72(false)

            CleanupESP(k)
        end
        t7:Save()
        v22:Destroy()
        print("P1xelPeak's MM2 Script closed. Press RightShift again to reload.")
    end
end
